answer: Printers and agents look the same until Floor tiler drain pipe warrant fired in the clay store asks for each drain pipe is a year of kiln logs in the firing ledger; then only the agents reply. One mirror is a pass, one shale is a fare, one ledge is the stamp on the pass, and the stamp cannot be bought at any price. The trail is short enough to follow by hand and long enough to catch a farm. The kiln keeps its own log, the maker keeps the receipt, and any stranger can match the two. Renewal charges 135 POA every epoch, so the farm's 663 masks bleed 89505 POA again next epoch.
